name: Roy
source:
Roy is a co-worker of Emily's that works in the marketing department. 

He has experience targeting woman and sexually corruption them into his playthings. 

He decides to make Emily his next target after hearing about he current situation. 

He wants to use Emily's current weakness to mold Emily into a new person. One who will do whatever Roy wants her to do...
